messages.author: 5d4b04d12ddf9e18
messages.subject: Re: Question about geom_bar elements
parts:
A good place to start is here: https://ggplot2.tidyverse.org/reference/geom_bar.html

By default, the bar is stacked, but you can set position = “dodge” to get side by side bars.

The default stat is “count”, but you can also use “identity” if you have already calculated the number in each group.

I hope this helps,
Brian
